title: A KEY OPENS THE DOOR FOR THE WHOLE PARTY
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08: in co-op, a locked room opened with its key opened only in the window that used the key. The key is single use, so the other player could never get into that room, could not search the caches inside, and still saw the door as locked. Opening a door is now told to the party and every window opens it; a player who joins late finds it open too.
now: In co-op, a locked room opened with its key is open for both players.
